description: A muted slate-blue wool apron dress over a fine natural cream linen shift, small simple paired bronze brooches, restrained grey tablet-woven borders and a narrow woven belt. The dress falls to the ankles with both brown leather shoes visible below. Let the linen neckline and elbow-length sleeves follow the stated moderate normal clothing-coverage layer without transparency. The fabrics are opaque, clean and practical, with modest prosperous workmanship; no regalia, armor, head covering, weapons or heraldry.
